notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
New Equipment

 Fiber Optic Cable: Adds a 4th option when picking upgrades. If you've already completed the requirements to unlock this equipment, it will become available after your next run (including abandoned runs).

General

 You can now reinstall weapons destroyed by Specializer. After gaining additional weapon slots, your original weapons will appear in the upgrade rotation at their previous level.
 The Completionist legendary now uses the phrase "EXP orb" to be consistent with other text in the game
 Added extra text to clarify that "on heal" abilities trigger even when healing at full HP
 The final Spread Invert upgrade now says "+2 bullets to all abilities" in order to better reflect what it actually does. Previously, it stated it only applied to weapons.
 Updated gold bonus on stage reward screen to say "challenge reward" in order to better reflect that the gold is coming from completed challenges

Balance

 Assassin Protocol: No longer adds 1s cooldown
 Weapon Mount: Now gives +10% EXP
 Rubber Plating: No longer reduces the player’s outgoing crash damage
 Attribute Wall: Increased cooldown/fire rate bonus per shield from 1% to 1.5%
 Chakram: Increased starting size

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where Chakram would lag behind the player when playing at less than 120 FPS
 Fixed a similar issue where some Stage 2 enemies would form a tighter circle than intended depending on framerate
 The Max FPS setting now properly takes affect when restarting the game
 Certain Stage 3 enemies can no longer be knocked off the screen
 Killing an enemy offscreen will no longer trigger Completionist damage due to the EXP spawning offscreen
 EXP from equipment and miniboss loot is no longer destroyed by leaving the screen
 Fixed an issue where fashion items dropped more frequently than intended

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.4
notes.notes:
General

 Leveling up after maxing out your upgrades will now give a choice between HP and cryptogold
 Performance improvements

Balance

 Titanium Plating now also improves all cooldowns by 1% of max HP

Bug fixes

 Fixed a soft lock that could happen when picking the Chaos Drive legendary
 Fixed a crash that could happen when picking the Microtracers legendary
 Fixed an issue where explosion debris wasn't rendering on high graphic settings

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.3
notes.notes:
This patch focuses on better support for ultra wide screen and other aspect ratios. 

General

 Player and enemy size now remains constant, regardless of aspect ratio. Ultra wide screen should no longer feel "zoomed in".
 New title screen background, plus the title screen uses the proper layout on all aspect ratios
 Stage backgrounds look better when using tall aspect ratios (4:3, etc)
 Misc visual polish

Bug fixes

 The Viper miniboss is no longer halfway off the screen when using ultra wide resolutions
 Fixed an issue where the stage complete progress bar didn't fill up all the way when using ultra wide resolutions
 The boss warning no longer blocks the level up window

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.2
notes.notes:
Closing out 2023 with one last patch.

General

 New music
 Visual polish

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue that can occur when applying the Specializer upgrade to one of the Spread weapons
 Fixed an issue where the player couldn't crash into the Stage 1 boss on the left side, and another issue where the player wouldn't bounce out after crashing into the boss
 Collecting two boss loots back-to-back will no longer cause the player to miss out on EXP

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.1
notes.notes:
Balance

 Stage 1: Laser mini-bosses will now follow the player (same as in the beta). Having them stay still just wasn't as interesting.
 Stage 1: Added 2 more mini-bosses. The goal is to give new players more chances at legendary loot. Newer players tended to avoid the bosses and let them time out, and were missing out on a core game mechanic by not getting the boss drops.
 Stage 1: Added a few more moments where you feel like you're totally going to die
 Stage 1: The stage boss has a new strategy: wiggle up and down slightly. This masterful counters the player's preferred strategy of standing perfectly still in the tiny gap between lasers.
 Codex: Increased EXP gain from 40% to 50%
 Unstable Encyclopedia: Reduced EXP by half, size from 500% to 400%, and damage from 250 to 200

General

 Updated the DPS calculation. For the statisticians reading this and wondering how DPS can be calculated multiple ways, consider this example: a bullet with 10 damage hits an enemy with 1 hp. Previous system would count this as 10 damage, but the new system counts this as 1.
 Additional visual polish

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where increasing legendary drop rate actually decreased drop rate
 EXP can no longer spawn partially off-screen

notes.title: Big update! New items and mechanics
notes.notes:
New mechanics

 Rerolls have been added. When used, you'll get a new set of upgrades to choose from. Rerolls are added by equipping certain ship parts in the hangar.
 One additional equipment slot can now be unlocked and purchased.

New abilities and equipment

 Flux Capacitor. Gain +2 rerolls. Unlocked by earning 800 stage bonus EXP across all runs. If you've already earned that much in the demo, the item will unlock the next time you start a run.
 Regen Gear Adv. Heal 1% HP every 5 seconds. Unlocked by equipping a Hull and still failing a stage. 
 Heavy Matter Compactor has been replaced by Big Bullet. +100% damage, +100% size. Reduce bullets by 25%.

General

 Second miniboss is slightly easier.
 Changed some icons.

Bug Fixes

 The reward window will no longer be off the screen when you've unlocked a large amount of achievements in a single run.
 Fixed an issue where some SFX weren't properly rate limited.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.3
notes.notes:
General

 A settings window has been added to the pause menu, allowing for volume to be changed during gameplay. Most graphical options still need to be changed from the main menu.
 Added visual and audio polish for settings window and intro screens
 Balance updates for Stage 2

Bug Fixes

 You can no longer clip into the boss to avoid all damage (pro strat)
 Fixed an issue that occurred when using the Specializer legendary to remove Dark Matter Bomb in the time between a bomb was fired and the bomb explodes

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.2
notes.notes:
This patch focuses on reducing grind and making some parts of the game slightly easier.


 Failed runs award more Crypto Gold.
 Increased stage bonus EXP by 20%.
 Reduced how much damage the player can take in a short timespan, making it harder to suddenly die from an enemy swarm or a row of bullets.
 Increased Dark Matter Field's starting pierce stat from 2 to 3.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.1
notes.notes:
Balance

 Heavy Matter Compactor now also gives +1 pierce. This legendary was nerfed too much after the beta, so giving it a boost.


Bug fixes

 Fixed an occasional crash that occurred once all fashion items were unlocked
 The text for fashion rewards is now properly centered in the reward window

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
Greetings pilots. Today we enter a new stage of the game's development - demo time. Unlike the previous beta events, the demo will be available to play at any time.

How to participate?
Visit the store page and click the download button. Done.

If you played the beta, the demo will be a separate app.

What's new?
Permanent Progression
Your save file will carry over to the full game.

Some of the unlocks and challenges have been reworked since the last beta. For the grind enjoyers, crypto gold is capped at 9999. Don't go too crazy.

Fashion
Customize your ship and engine trail. Earn new outfits by completing runs.

Full Gamepad Support
Use a gamepad everywhere. And for the hardcore shmup fans, joystick should work too. No more under construction beta menus that require a mouse.

Goodbye Stage 1
The desert stage available during beta is no longer playable. Don't worry! It will be back with redesigned enemy encounters.

Lore and Flavor Text
Learn the dark history of a galaxy rapidly conquered by the Theocracy of Eden. Serve your god-emperors as a Faithkeeper, the highest level of star pilot.

How to give feedback?
Join us on Discord. Feedback is welcome and improves the game!
